messages:
ben-ml: kicking off quant bakeoff for equinox-7b across AWQ/GPTQ/FP8/INT8. seeing weird perf regressions on Triton container w/ CUDA 12.2 + vLLM binding — failing to hit KV cache warmup, spikes in latency.

maya-research: thx. can you paste the exact command + container tag?

ben-ml: running with:
```bash
docker run --gpus all -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 \ 
  -v /models/equinox-7b:/mnt/model \ 
  redwood/triton-llm:cuda12.2-v1 ./run_bench --quant awq --batch 1 --seq 1024
```
latency graph attached (will upload to drive). spikes on first 30s then steady but ~2x expected tokens/s.

samir-rt: any driver errors in dmesg or triton logs? kernel timeouts?

ben-ml: triton log snippet:
```
[2026-02-15 14:21:05] WARN TritonModelInstance: failed to allocate KV cache batch 8 -> falling back to per-token copy
[2026-02-15 14:21:06] ERROR cuda_runtime: CUDA error 700: an illegal memory access was encountered
```
no kernel panic, container stays up.

li-ops: could be mismatch between our TRT-LLM plugin and CUDA12.2. try forcing `TRITON_DISABLE_FAST_KV=1` and set `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libtcmalloc.so` to see mem behavior.

maya-research: also try running vLLM backend directly (no Triton) to isolate. AWQ path sometimes trips Triton kernel selection. `pip install vllm==0.9.2` + run simple server.

ben-ml: ran vLLM direct: no illegal memory access, AWQ perf slightly lower but stable. suggests triton-plugin mismatch. open to test with CUDA 11.8 image too.

samir-rt: FYI we patched TRT-LLM symbol export in 1.2.4 to avoid fallback; older containers might call older kernels. Which trt-llm tag? 

ben-ml: trt-llm 1.2.1 in container. will repro with 1.2.4.

deploy-bot: build 2026-02-15T14:34:02 pushed: redwood/triton-llm:cuda12.2-v1.2.4

ben-ml: repro on 1.2.4: still see WARN but CUDA error gone. throughput back to expected for AWQ+INT8, FP8 path still has ~8% accuracy delta on LAMBADA vs FP16 baseline.

maya-research: interesting — drop could be quant calibration issue. share calibration set? we used short prompts earlier.

ben-ml: used 512-sample calibration, will expand to 2k diverse examples.

li-ops: schedule larger bakeoff on dedicated pool tomorrow 0300 UTC to avoid noisy neighbors. I'll reserve L40s.

samir-rt: once we have results, let's run regression eval in Redwood Optimize (per-route checks) and add automatic rollback if accuracy < -5%.

ben-ml: plan: 1) expand calib 2) run AWQ/GPTQ/INT8/FP8 on trt-llm 1.2.4 + vLLM direct 3) collect perf+quality and post summary. tagging @maya-research @li-ops @samir-rt :thumbsup:

maya-research: 👍

li-ops: booking done, ping when artifacts uploaded.

infra-bot: note: scheduled maintenance for CUDA drivers on 2026-02-16 05:00 UTC. may affect runs.

ben-ml: noted — will move heavy runs earlier. thanks.
